collection.name: HoodYØØR
collection.description: HoodYØØR is a collection of 3,333 dynamic Droids built for Robinhood Chain. Every 128×128 image and its metadata are generated entirely onchain from a frozen 201-trait catalog. Holders can spend non-transferable Energy to reroll mutable traits while each Droid’s background and body remain locked. DYOR—and stay in the hood.
collection.disclaimer: Independent collection built for Robinhood Chain. Not affiliated with Robinhood Markets, Inc.
